key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 4.25% approaching the 4% target and core inflation moderating to 5.02%, the current repo rate of 6.50% provides a positive real interest rate that is appropriate for the current growth-inflation balance. Given the GVA growth of 7.80% and the need to support a durable post-pandemic recovery, a shift to a neutral stance is warranted to avoid over-tightening while remaining vigilant against supply-side shocks.
